text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Flash-san.
The sweets you gave me the other day were delicious.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm glad you like it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ah. Come to think of it, you mentioned before that you were working on a sculpture, right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I'm thinking of making a marzipan cake sometime. Would you care to join me?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
A confectionery craft for me?
Why yes, that would be lovely.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Will this amount of carrots do for mixing into the sponge cake base?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Perfectly minced.
Magnificent knife work.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Now next, we put the dough mixture
into the bread maker... Hm?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The machine isn't responding... That's a problem.
If I have to knead it by hand, it'll take so much time...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you knead it with more strength than a machine,
it'll be done faster, right?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: In that case, would you leave it to me?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes, if that's the case, I'd appreciate it, but—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: If you apply too much pressure, you risk damaging the fabric's texture, so please be careful.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
(――...Since my fingers sink into the dough,
it's tricky to gauge the right pressure...)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, keep it even—!
Apply just the right amount of force, swiftly—!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—It came out wonderfully!
I believe it is all thanks to the dough being kneaded to perfection.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Since it doesn't burst or shatter,
it was much easier to handle.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
(...Still, that sensation of kneading the dough.
I feel like I grasped something...)
Having gained a new sensation, Gentildonna polished her running even further.
